explain.undefinedCommand: The command {{name}} does not exist: a typo, or the package defining it is not loaded in the preamble.
explain.undefinedEnvironment: The environment {{name}} is not defined anywhere: check its name or load the package that provides it.
explain.missingDollar: A math command (^, _, \alpha…) is used outside math mode: wrap it in $…$, or a $ was opened and never closed.
explain.fileNotFound: The file {{name}} cannot be found: check its name and folder, or the package is not installed in TeX Live.
explain.extraBrace: A closing brace } has no matching opening brace.
explain.missingBrace: A brace is missing: an opening { was never closed, often in a command argument.
explain.mismatchedEnvironment: The environment {{name}} is closed by an \end that does not match it: check the order of \begin and \end.
explain.missingBeginDocument: Text appears before \begin{document}, or that line is missing: the preamble may only contain settings.
explain.undefinedReference: The label {{name}} does not exist, or the document must be compiled again for the reference to update.
explain.undefinedCitation: The key {{name}} is not in the loaded .bib files, or the bibliography has not been generated yet.
explain.duplicateLabel: The label {{name}} is defined more than once: each \label needs a unique name.
explain.runawayArgument: The file ends while the argument of {{name}} is still open: a closing brace } is missing.
explain.paragraphEnded: A blank line interrupts the argument of {{name}}: a closing brace is probably missing before it.
explain.misplacedAlignment: The & character is only allowed in a table or an alignment; elsewhere, write \&.
explain.noLineToEnd: A \\ comes where no line has started, for example right after a list or at the start of a paragraph.
explain.doubleScript: Two superscripts or two subscripts follow each other: group them with braces, for example x^{ab}.
explain.unicodeCharacter: The character {{name}} is not supported by this engine: use the equivalent LaTeX command, or compile with XeLaTeX or LuaLaTeX.
explain.optionClash: The package {{name}} is loaded twice with different options: put all the options in a single \usepackage.
explain.missingNumber: A length or a number is expected here but none was found.
explain.illegalUnit: A length is given without a valid unit: write for example 2cm, 10pt or 0.5\textwidth.
explain.fontNotFound: The font {{name}} is not installed on the compilation server.
